steps.assertion: All three actions coexist on an immediate payment
steps.text: Open the posted bill from **Accounting > Vendors > Bills**. When a bank line of the same partner matches it within the allowed days and rate deviation, the outstanding box offers three actions: the native **Add**, **Settle immediately** and **Use payment rate**, the recommended one in colour.
**Best match** names the bank line Odoo compared the bill with; open it when you want to see the other candidates.
Choose **Use payment rate**. The bill is revalued at the rate the bank payment implies, so no exchange difference is written.

steps.assertion: The invoice shows one concise settlement trace
steps.text: The bill is paid and a single line records the settlement: the mechanism, and **no FX** when nothing was booked for the exchange.
Choose the info icon on the payment line.

steps.assertion: Source facts and the document repricing remain inspectable
steps.text: The detail keeps the facts: what Odoo had estimated and discarded, the original value of the document, its value at the payment rate, and the entries involved.
steps.trigger: .account_payment_popover:contains('Use payment rate'):contains('Discarded Odoo estimate'):contains('Original document value'):contains('Payment-rate document value')

steps.text: **Unreconcile** reverses the whole settlement in one step when the match was wrong.

steps.assertion: Reversal restores the open document and all actions
steps.text: The bill is open again at its original value and the three actions are offered once more.

title: Settle a foreign-currency bill at the payment rate
